notes:
Sales GST Summary — accuracy fix + Export to Excel:

• Fixed a real overcounting bug: totals could come out several times too high on wide date ranges, caused by Tally's own request-caching bleeding between the month-by-month chunks introduced to avoid the earlier crash. Every voucher is now also deduplicated by its own unique ID before totals are calculated, so counts stay correct even if that happens again.

• Added an "Export to Excel" button — the same client-wise Taxable Value / CGST / SGST / IGST / Non-GST Sales breakdown you see on screen, saved as a branded, print-ready workbook with a Totals row at the bottom.
